text: Biomedical science is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates biology, medicine, engineering and information technology. It focuses on solving medical problems through engineering and technical means and exploring the essence of life phenomena. The major takes "integration of medicine and engineering" as its core, aiming to cultivate students' mastery of technologies such as biomedical signal processing, medical image analysis, and medical device design. Students can not only engage in equipment research and development and clinical testing in the medical field but also participate in the breakthrough of cutting-edge biomedical technologies in research institutions, thus becoming compound talents with interdisciplinary innovation capabilities
